title: Logarithmic output trim and geometric stage certificates

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Uniform P/empty-witness NP verifier in proof.md. The controller selects least u(p), uniformly in polynomial time. C_B2(Trim_N)>=4N-8u_N+4 for EVERY integer N>=0. At EVERY sufficiently large integer N, u_N<=2^ceil(D_trim Z), D_trim=139829/50000=2.79658, Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)),L=ceil(log2 N),B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Consequently for each fixed epsilon>0, C_B2(Trim_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer lengths and this SAME fixed eligible family has liminf C_B2(Trim_N)/N>=4.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

experiments.purpose: Exact262144-term energy/confidence mesh and two parameter-only SU constructor cases. Generic full-B2 proof is analytical; no field tables, raw extractor outputs, accepted tree or gate enumeration is executed.
